column1: # Machine-readable list of every third-party or own asset, dataset and vendored file (PLAT-21).
# Columns (tab separated): path, name, author, licence, source URL, use.
# path: a glob in the repository (** crosses folders), crate:NAME for data inside a Cargo crate,
#   or ext:ID for data that is not in the repository (fetched at run time or made at build time).
# licence: an SPDX expression. The ids are in docs/attribution-licences.txt.
# use: `ships` for what goes into the installers or the web build, `test` for the rest (tests, docs, tools).
#   A third-party row that ships needs its name in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
# author "Kadakas project" marks our own work. The own-work source is the repository URL in Cargo.toml.
# UNKNOWN (licence, source or author) is only for a path under tests/, testdata/ or fixtures/.
#   Such a row needs every file that it matches named in docs/attribution-open.txt.
